name: Glorious Icewater Bubble Hash Infused Pre-Roll | Honolulu Blue
description:
Smells like the first whiff at a playoff win in 31 years and tastes like grit and determination!

This strain is gassy! The terps are loud, boasting huge, dank gas with earthy undertones along with an ever so slight gelato-ey cream smell. The smoke is smooth and the high is heavy.
